title: FIRES FIT THE MAP
why: His answer of 2026-10-14: fire hazards also in random spots, not only from wrecks and events, and they must fit the map: on open real ground, never through or on buildings or walls, never on the map edges, never on the drop or the rings. The fires were put wherever the middle of the disc was free, so a disc of 92 could lie across a wall, a building corner or a tree. A fire now needs its whole disc to fit: clear of every wall, tree and piece of furniture, the middle not in a building or in water, no box lying in it, clear of a stronghold, away from the map edge, at least 300 from any extraction ring and clear of the drop. The two random fuel fires of a raid look 140 times for such a place, and the debris fires of the orbital debris event are placed the same way, so a piece that would land on a wall or a building is moved onto open ground.
now: Fires now sit on open ground that fits the map, never across walls or buildings.
